products.name: Move Inventory Change Register
products.product: A focused moving inventory change authorization workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent household moving companies and local moving crews
products.problem: Added items, access conditions, packing work, dates, and address changes can alter labor and price after the estimate, but field and office teams may work from different scope versions.
products.valueProposition: Turns moving inventory change authorization into a visible operating queue so every material move change is priced, authorized, and published to dispatch and crew before the affected work proceeds.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets moving inventory change order, moving estimate revision, mover scope change, and moving company change authorization searches.

products.name: Crew Arrival Readiness
products.product: A focused moving crew arrival readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent household moving companies and local moving crews
products.problem: Crews lose time when addresses, access windows, contacts, parking, inventory, equipment, paperwork, or customer confirmations are incomplete at dispatch.
products.valueProposition: Turns moving crew arrival readiness into a visible operating queue so every dispatched crew leaves with a confirmed job scope, access plan, equipment load, and customer arrival promise.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets moving crew checklist, moving day dispatch, mover job readiness, and moving company pre move confirmation searches.

products.name: Damage Claim Evidence Desk
products.product: A focused moving company damage claim evidence tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent household moving companies and local moving crews
products.problem: Written claims, shipment identity, inventory numbers, photos, valuation terms, estimates, deadlines, and customer updates arrive through separate channels.
products.valueProposition: Turns moving company damage claim evidence tracking into a visible operating queue so every damage or loss claim is acknowledged, completed with required evidence, reviewed, and resolved with a documented decision.
products.topic: moving company damage claim evidence tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets moving damage claim tracker, mover claims software, moving loss damage documentation, and moving claim evidence searches.
